Provider: Università della Svizzera italiana

In order to further promote the multilingual and multicultural composition of the student body — which, in line with USI’s objectives, has proven to be highly valuable even for Italian-speaking students — USI offers scholarships to students from the German- and French-speaking cantons of Switzerland.

This scholarship is automatically awarded to all newly enrolled first-year Bachelor students and covers the annual tuition fee of CHF 4,000.–.
